subject: PO reference allocation and spend-cap adjustment for Acme Cloud onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Reeves <jordan.reeves@acmecloud.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: k.novak@procureplus.io
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding & PO reference needed to start provisioning

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the intro call earlier — excited to get Acme Cloud set up on Redwood. To unblock provisioning we need a purchase reference/PO assigned that we can map to our billing system. Attached is our standard vendor onboarding form and an initial invoice schedule with three line items (monthly subscription + integration services + one-time onboarding).

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood prefers a single consolidated PO or separate line-item POs for subscription vs services?
- What spend cap we should expect while we validate traffic (we expect ramping usage month 1 -> month 3).

We also need the company tax ID and an internal contact for escalation. Happy to send any additional docs.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_ACME.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme_invoice_schedule_v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Jordan Reeves
Head of Partnerships
Acme Cloud Solutions
jordan.reeves@acmecloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Jordan Reeves <jordan.reeves@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding & PO reference needed to start provisioning

Jordan — thanks for the detail and the attachments. Looping in Marissa from Procurement to propose a PO reference and initial spend cap.

Answers up-front: we can do either a single PO with line-item breakdowns or multiple POs if your finance team prefers separate accounting buckets. For speed I recommend a single PO with two line items: subscription (recurring) and professional services (one-time). If you need separate legal contract references for each, let us know.

Quick ask for Procurement: Marissa, can you confirm a provisional PO reference we can give Acme to start provisioning? Also flag if we should request additional tax paperwork (W9/CT-REG) before final PO issuance.

Jordan — can you send your tax ID in the onboarding form and confirm whether the onboarding item should be billed upfront or net-30?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sales Operations 
Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0910

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, Jordan Reeves <jordan.reeves@acmecloud.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding & PO reference needed to start provisioning

Hi Priyom / Jordan — assigning provisional reference and initial spend cap below so the engineering team can provision while Finance finalizes approvals.

Provisional purchase reference: PO-ACME-PROV-0047
Planned final PO: PO-ACME-0047 (issued after vendor verification)
Initial spend cap (provisional): $150,000 USD (valid for 30 days; can be revised with finance sign-off)
Billing suggestion: single PO with two canonical line items: 1) Redwood Hosted Subscription (monthly recurring), 2) Integration & Onboarding (one-time). We prefer line-item granularity for cost-center tagging.

Action items for Acme:
- Update the onboarding form with your Tax ID (EIN) and indicate billing term (Net 30 / Net 45).
- Provide a final line-item breakdown with cost-center assignation if you want charges split across multiple charge codes. If not provided, charges will hit the consolidated subscription code.

Note: if you need the onboarding one-time billed to a separate cost center, Procurement will issue a PO amendment to include sub-lineitem allocations. That requires the vendor to provide a clear split of amounts per cost center.

I attached the internal PO allocation guide and a basic template for line-item splits.

Attachments: procurement_po_allocation_guide.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Jordan Reeves <jordan.reeves@acmecloud.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding & PO reference needed to start provisioning

Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround. A couple of clarifications: 

1) Line items: Our accounting would prefer to consolidate the professional services into the single onboarding line (one one-time line) rather than creating sub-lineitems — we can provide a single invoice with a clear description that maps to your subscription tier. If Redwood needs split cost-center tagging, we can also provide an internal breakdown spreadsheet but prefer one invoice total.

2) Spend cap: Based on the ramp we expect, can you consider $180,000 as the provisional spend cap? That covers volume + burst for the first 90 days. If not, please advise the approval path and timeline.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form_ACME_updated.xlsx (completed with EIN 54-3210987), acme_invoice_schedule_v2.xlsx (consolidated one-time onboarding amount).

Let me know if we should sign anything else or if legal needs an additional clause.

—Jordan

Subject: Final PO issuance and adjusted cap (PO-ACME-0047)

Jordan — following up after Finance review. We reviewed your forecast and the requested consolidation approach and issued the final PO with a moderated increase. Details below: 

Final PO: PO-ACME-0047
Final approved spend cap: $170,000 USD (approved by Finance with note: revisit at 60 days based on actual burn)
Line-item treatment: Per your request we've consolidated professional services into a single onboarding line. Procurement added an internal allocation tag so Redwood can split chargebacks in accounting without requiring multiple POs. If you later need separate POs per cost center, we can do an amendment.

Attachments included: ACME_PO_2026-0047.pdf (official PO document), vendor_onboarding_form_ACME_updated.xlsx (final).

DocuSign link for PO signature: https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC-PO-0047

Please confirm receipt and whether the consolidated invoice schedule works for your AR team. Once you sign the DocuSign link we can flip the provisioning switch.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
